map.→ 打开投诉分类分析工具: -> Open the complaint classification analysis tool
map.分类关键词可以自定义吗？: Can the classification keywords be customised?
map.分类覆盖率低说明什么？: What does a low classification coverage rate mean?
map.可以。页面提供关键词输入框，按「类别:词1,词2;类别2:词…」格式填写即可覆盖: Yes. The page provides a keyword input box; filling it in the format "category:word1,word2;category2:word..." overrides the default keyword library and fits different business scenarios (e-commerce / SaaS / physical stores).
map.录入客户投诉文本，自动按类别打标分类，统计各问题类型分布、高频词与处理优先级，用: Paste customer complaint text to have it tagged and classified automatically by category, and see the distribution of issue types, high-frequency words and handling priority, for service review, public opinion monitoring and process improvement.
map.投诉归类：粘贴多条投诉文本，工具按预设关键词（物流/质量/服务/价格/售后）逐行: Complaint grouping: paste several complaint texts and the tool matches them line by line against preset keywords (logistics/quality/service/price/after-sales), classifies them automatically and counts the number and share of each type.
map.改进聚焦：通过「分类覆盖率」指标识别未归类的「其他」投诉，结合高频词（去停用词）: Improvement focus: use the "classification coverage rate" to find complaints still sitting in "other", combine it with frequent words (stopwords removed) to uncover new pain points, and iterate the keyword library.
map.日报生成：输出各类型投诉条数、占比与词频 Top20，直接用于质量例会、供应商或: Daily report: output per-type complaint counts, shares and the top 20 word frequencies, ready for quality meetings and supplier or logistics accountability.
map.覆盖率 = (总投诉数 − 未归类「其他」数) ÷ 总投诉数。偏低意味着大量投诉: Coverage rate = (total complaints − uncategorised "other") ÷ total complaints. A low rate means many complaints missed the keywords, so expand the library or distil frequent "other" samples into new categories to keep improving automatic classification.
map.：默认词库：物流(配送/快递/发货/慢/延迟/到货)、质量(质量/坏了/破损/缺: : default keywords: logistics (delivery/courier/shipping/slow/delayed/arrival), quality (quality/broken/damaged/defective/substandard), service (attitude/customer service/ignored), price (expensive/price rise/pricing/charges), after-sales (refund/return/repair). Enter 6 samples: ① "the courier is too slow and the logistics info never updates" → logistics; ② "the product has a quality defect" → quality; ③ "bad customer service attitude, nobody answers" → service; ④ "the price is too expensive" → price; ⑤ "the refund process is a hassle and I want to return it" → after-sales; ⑥ "I am in a bad mood today" → other. Result: 1 each for logistics/quality/service/price/after-sales/other, coverage = (6-1)/6 ≈ 83%, meaning 5 of 6 complaints were classified effectively.
